## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This one-fascicle commentary on [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's *[Wǔ jiào zhāng 五教章](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0074)* (T1866) is by [希迪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%8C%E8%BF%AA) Xīdí, the Southern Sòng Huìyīnsì 慧因寺 abbot. The *jíchéng jì* 集成記 ("compilation notes") format is more synthetic and integrative than [師會](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%9C%83) Shīhuì's polemical *Fù gǔ jì* 復古記: rather than refuting [道亭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E4%BA%AD) Dàotíng's earlier readings, Xīdí's commentary attempts to gather the best of multiple commentary traditions into a coherent reading.

**Abstract**

The work is precisely datable per the DILA Authority entry (A000487) to *Jiādìng* 嘉定 11 (1218 CE), composed at the Wǔlín Huìyīnsì 武林慧因寺 when Xīdí was abbot. The bracket adopted here (1218 – 1218) reflects this exact dating. The doctrinal substance is a synthetic exposition of Fǎzàng's *Five Teachings* schema drawing on the entire commentarial tradition (Dàotíng, Shīhuì, [善熹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%86%B9) Shànxī).

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* 續藏經 (X999) collection.
